info.headline: Flood Warning issued September 16 at 9:06AM CDT until September 20 at 7:13PM CDT by NWS Tallahassee FL

parameters.name: NWSheadline
parameters.value: The Flood Warning is now in effect until Sunday evening

info.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Alabama...

Pea River near Ariton (US 231) affecting Dale and Coffee Counties.

For the Pea River...including Ariton (US 231)...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

The Flood Warning continues for
the Pea River near Ariton (US 231).
* From this evening to Sunday evening.
* At 8:00 AM CDT Wednesday the stage was 2.7 feet.
* Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
* Moderate flooding is forecast.
* Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
this evening to a crest of 20.0 feet Friday morning. It will then
fall below flood stage Sunday morning.
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 915 PM CDT.
